titleEn: Minimum Moves to Make Array Complementary
title: 使数组互补的最少操作次数
summary: 每次把一个元素改为 1 到 limit；使所有对称位置元素之和相等，求最少修改次数。
insight: 对每个对称数对，目标和在 [2,2limit] 上的代价呈分段常数：通常两次、落在一改可达区间时一次、等于原和时零。用差分数组叠加所有分段。
pitfalls: 每对元素独立贡献零到两次修改
一改可达区间为 min+1 到 max+limit
扫描目标和时累加差分得到总代价

solutions.title: 目标和代价差分
solutions.idea: 批量记录每个数对在目标和轴上的代价变化点。
steps: diff[2]+=2 表示每对默认两次修改
在 min+1 降一、原和再降一、原和+1 加一、max+limit+1 再加一
对所有数对更新后从和二扫描前缀，取最小代价

code.java: class Solution { public int minMoves(int[] nums,int limit){int[] difference=new int[2*limit+2];for(int left=0,right=nums.length-1;left<right;left++,right--){int low=Math.min(nums[left],nums[right]),high=Math.max(nums[left],nums[right]),sum=low+high;difference[2]+=2;difference[low+1]--;difference[sum]--;difference[sum+1]++;difference[high+limit+1]++;}int moves=0,answer=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int sum=2;sum<=2*limit;sum++){moves+=difference[sum];answer=Math.min(answer,moves);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minMoves(nums:IntArray,limit:Int):Int{val difference=IntArray(2*limit+2);var left=0;var right=nums.lastIndex;while(left<right){val low=minOf(nums[left],nums[right]);val high=maxOf(nums[left],nums[right]);val sum=low+high;difference[2]+=2;difference[low+1]--;difference[sum]--;difference[sum+1]++;difference[high+limit+1]++;left++;right--};var moves=0;var answer=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(sum in 2..2*limit){moves+=difference[sum];answer=minOf(answer,moves)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minMoves(vector<int>& nums,int limit){vector<int> difference(2*limit+2);for(int left=0,right=nums.size()-1;left<right;++left,--right){int low=min(nums[left],nums[right]),high=max(nums[left],nums[right]),sum=low+high;difference[2]+=2;--difference[low+1];--difference[sum];++difference[sum+1];++difference[high+limit+1];}int moves=0,answer=INT_MAX;for(int sum=2;sum<=2*limit;++sum){moves+=difference[sum];answer=min(answer,moves);}return answer;} };
